# WE2 · Ảnh trước / sau · so sánh trượt

Group **WE · Ảnh, bác sĩ & phòng, dịch vụ** · state · Next.js: **built (U4)** (`/studio`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#photos`
- Studio is `clinic.js › studio()/photos()`; resources and services are `operations-ui.js › resources()/services()` with the dialogs `block` and `service`.
- `studioMode = 'slider'` (button "So sánh trượt"): one image with a clip-path overlay of the "before" image, a zoom range `#studio-zoom` and a position range `#comparison-slider`; the chip "Trước ← → Sau" labels the two halves.
- Inventory note: Illustrative photos only; no efficacy score.
- Page key `studio` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"studio\"]"} → {"click":"[data-action=\"studio-mode\"]"} → {"wait":"#comparison-slider"}; it must show `#comparison-slider`.
